notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.3.1
notes.content:
Changes

Improved movement sync for much better latency tolerance 

Added a camera effect while running 

Added a VFX effect at impact while shooting 



Bug fixes 

Fixes players score being updated during non-game state match

Fixes players score not being reset when switching from waiting for players to the actual match

Fixes room not being terminated if no one joined it after its creation

Fixes chat input being invisible for 2K+ screens

Fixes random rendering issues caused by MSAA being applied twice

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.3.0
notes.content:
Features 



Added a server browser to join the room you want 

Added the ability to create a room (Note: for now, only one room can exist simultaneously. Unlimited rooms will be enabled for v0.3.1, after verifying auto-removal of empty room is working as expected) 



Changes



Greatly improved shadows 

Reduced chat font size 



Bug fixes 



Fixed inconsistent player collider height after crouching 

Fixed cases where pressing keys on the keyboard would result in random page changes on the main menu

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.2.1
notes.content:
Features



Players will now respawn at different positions during match.



Changes



Improved lanterns visuals.

Increased pistol damage.



Bug fixes



(Regression) Fixes dash going only forward.

(Regression) Fixes dash not working near slopes.

Fixes server authentication failing for no reason.

Fixes player rotation being tilted in some cases.

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.2.0
notes.content:
Features



Added match system. Only free-for-all gamemode is enabled for now.



Changes



Updated character 3D model.

Updated rifle 3D model.

Improved character visuals and lighting system.

Running while going backwards is now slower.

DirectX12 is now supported and is now used by default.

Slightly improved CPU performance.



Bug fixes



Fixes dash exploit when looking at a wall.

Fixes kill feed's usernames being not visible for 2K+ screens.

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.1.2
notes.content:
Changes


 Removed free looking mode,
 Crouching position is now synchronized,


Bug fixes


 (Regression) Fixes disconnection when receiving a chat message,
 Fixes player desync after respawn,
 Fixes players nameplates being visible through walls

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.1.1
notes.content:
Features


 Damage numbers are now displayed when shooting at another player

Changes


 Simplified character slot creation
 Character below the map will now die instantly
 Improved air control while flying/jumping


Bug fixes


 Fixes dash orientation being incorrect when looking up
 Fixes rare case where the character list wouldn't load
 Fixes muzzle flash not being properly displayed
 Fixes joining message using user id instead of username in the chat
 Fixes error the first time when trying to disconnect

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.1.0
notes.content:
Features

 Added game menu
 Added settings menu
 Added Steam authentication, replacing the manual one


Changes

 Lot of internal code changes were made to prepare for next updates, stuff might be broken
 Improved lighting performances

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.0.5
notes.content:
Bug fixes


 Fixes slight jitter occurring for synchronized movement
 Fixes invincibility after respawn
 Fixes movement desync after respawn
 Fixes endurance being wasted when pressing Shift key but not moving
 Fixes auto-scroll not occurring when chatbox was already open
 Fixes character position being persistent after reconnecting
 Fixes dash buffering being kept in memory even when there is not enough endurance
 Fixes character deletion not working

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.0.4
notes.content:
Features


 Added dash by right-clicking (consumes endurance)


Changes


 Improved endurance calculation
 Rolling is now happening only if the character have some velocity before falling


Bug fixes


 Fixes spriting mode being stuck as is once enabled
 Fixes player being stuck after respawning
 Fixes player being able to shoot while rolling
 Fixes incorrect muzzle flash when continuously firing
 Fixes possible exploit allowing for unlimited endurance

notes.title: V0.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Features


 New character controller system
 New input system with partial gamepad support
 New camera system
 Dynamic foot placement system
 Added discord integration


Changes


 Improved character's physics performance
 Improved running animation
 Improved muzzle flash effect
 Jump isn't possible anymore during land roll
 Reduced bandwidth usage by ~10%
 Reduced ranged weapon's recoil


Bug fixes


 Fixes a bug where current weapon isn't reloaded at respawn (for real this time)
 Fixes the character being stuck by a stair while walking
 Fixes character collider height not being updated when land rolling
 Fixes rolling animation being not synced
